sections.Profile:
Casino, released by Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co. in June 1972, is a four-player electro-mechanical pinball machine with a show business theme. Designed by Albin Peters and Jerry Koci, with artwork by Christian Marche, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, five stand-up targets, two spinning discs, and a kick-out hole.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1972
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
